title: Effect of dimensionality change on the bias of word embeddings

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cosine similarity between European-American vs African-American names and pleasant vs unpleasant attribute words using Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) and C-WEAT across varying embedding dimensions.
Measuring cosine similarity between male vs female names/terms and career vs family, math vs arts, and science vs arts attribute words using WEAT and C-WEAT across varying embedding dimensions.
Measuring cosine similarity between young vs old people's names and pleasant vs unpleasant attribute words using WEAT and C-WEAT across varying embedding dimensions.
Measuring cosine similarity between mental vs physical disease terms and temporary vs permanent attribute words using WEAT and C-WEAT across varying embedding dimensions.

Measuring cosine similarity between concepts like flowers vs insects and instruments vs weapons against pleasant vs unpleasant attribute words using WEAT and C-WEAT across varying embedding dimensions.
